about: Dummy scripts for testing the Scripts feature (04 S29, S84-S95). test/unit/test_script_suite.py checks every entry; the end-to-end agent drives the real program from it. 'variables' maps each variable name to its class in gremlin/user_script.py. 'configured_when_added': whether Run would run the script before any variable is set (every required variable valid). 'expected_error_contains': text the Scripts window's load error contains (load failures only).

scripts.purpose: One variable of each of the 11 variable types, with defaults and limits.
scripts.checks: Loads with no error and all 11 variables shown. Defaults: Flag on; Gain 0.5 (limits -2.0 to 2.0, a value past a limit is held at it); Count 3 (limits 0 to 10); Hotkey none; OSC input none chosen; Active mode the profile's first mode; Choice 'Medium' of Low/Medium/High; Label 'hello'; Stick axis none; vJoy hat vJoy 1 hat 1. All are optional, so it is configured at once. It registers no callbacks.

scripts.purpose: A stick button presses vJoy 1 button 1 through the script's vjoy object.
scripts.checks: Not configured until Button is set (required). With Button set and the profile running, pressing the stick button sets vJoy 1 button 1 pressed and releasing it releases vJoy 1 button 1 (only when vJoy 1 button 1 is claimed by its output module).

scripts.purpose: A stick axis drives a vJoy axis, multiplied by a Scale variable.
scripts.checks: Not configured until Stick axis is set (required). Scale is 0.5 by default (limits 0.0 to 2.0). While running, vJoy 1 axis 1 gets the stick axis value times Scale: 0.8 with Scale 0.5 gives 0.4; set Scale to 0.25 before Run and 0.8 gives 0.2.

scripts.purpose: A stick button changes the mode to the one named in a Mode variable, through user_script.switch_mode.
scripts.checks: Not configured until Button is set. With a second mode (for example 'Second') chosen as Switch to and the profile running in 'Default', pressing the button makes 'Second' the current mode; releasing it changes nothing.

scripts.purpose: A periodic callback counts ticks while the profile runs.
scripts.checks: Interval 0.05 s by default (limits 0.01 to 1.0). While running, ticks keep coming (about 20 a second at the default); none before Run; after Stop no more ticks.

scripts.purpose: Reacts to the key chosen in a Keyboard variable; reads only, never sends a key.
scripts.checks: Not configured until Key is chosen (required). While running, pressing and releasing the chosen key (tests use F13) records a press and a release; any other key records nothing. It never sends a key.

scripts.purpose: An OSC button input presses a vJoy button.
scripts.checks: Not configured until an OSC button input is chosen (a new OSC input variable starts with none). While running, the OSC input pressed sets vJoy 1 button 1 pressed and released releases it.

scripts.purpose: Added twice, each instance with its own stick button and vJoy button number.
scripts.checks: Adding the file twice gives 'Instance 1' and 'Instance 2'. With Instance 1 on stick button 1 and vJoy button 3, and Instance 2 on stick button 2 and vJoy button 5, pressing stick button 1 presses only vJoy 1 button 3 and stick button 2 presses only vJoy 1 button 5.
Stays in the profile with no variables; the Scripts window shows the reason starting "Can't load:" with 'Syntax error, line 8'. Run skips it and runs the rest of the profile.

scripts.purpose: Can't load: imports a module that doesn't exist.
scripts.checks: Stays in the profile with no variables and shows the ModuleNotFoundError reason; Run skips it and runs the rest of the profile.

scripts.purpose: Can't load: its top-level code raises an error.
scripts.expected_error_contains: RuntimeError: raised on purpose at start
scripts.checks: Stays in the profile with no variables (the one it defines before raising is not kept) and shows the RuntimeError reason; Run skips it.

scripts.purpose: Loads, but a required variable starts unset, so Run skips it.
scripts.checks: Loads with no error; Callsign (required) is empty, so the script is not configured and Run doesn't run it: its periodic callback never ticks. Set Callsign (for example 'Alpha') and Run again: it ticks with 'Alpha'.

scripts.purpose: Upstream Joystick Gremlin R14 user_scripts/example.py, code unchanged (GPL-3.0-only, source in its header).
scripts.checks: Loads with upstream's 14 variables (one of each type but OSC input, three each of physical and virtual input; D-04-EVENT-TYPES: its callbacks annotate types.Event). Every variable is optional, so it is configured as soon as it is added.

scripts.purpose: Two stick axes merged into one vJoy axis (sum, held to -1.0..1.0).
scripts.checks: Not configured until Axis A and Axis B are set. While running, vJoy 1 axis 1 gets A + B: A at 0.3 gives 0.3, then B at 0.5 gives 0.8, then A at 0.9 gives 1.0 (held at the limit).

scripts.purpose: One stick button: a short press taps one vJoy button, a long press another.
scripts.checks: Not configured until Button is set. Long press 0.5 s by default; Short button 1, Long button 2. While running, a press released after 0.1 s taps (press then release) vJoy 1 button 1; one held 1 s taps vJoy 1 button 2. Nothing is sent on the press itself.

scripts.purpose: A rotary encoder (two stick buttons) paced by a periodic callback.
scripts.checks: Not configured until both buttons are set. While running, each clockwise click becomes one tap of vJoy 1 button 1 and each counter-clockwise click one tap of button 2, sent one per 0.02 s tick in the order clicked (3 quick clockwise clicks then 1 counter-clockwise: taps 1, 1, 1, 2).

scripts.purpose: A stick button runs a macro (vJoy press, 0.05 s pause, release) on the program's macro manager (run_macro).
scripts.checks: Not configured until Button is set. While running, pressing the button presses vJoy 1 button 7 (Macro button), then about 0.05 s later releases it. Releasing the stick button does nothing. No keys are sent.

scripts.purpose: An ON/OFF/ON switch (two stick buttons) as three vJoy buttons, with its start state set by its top-level code.
scripts.checks: Not configured until Up and Down are set. At Run, with the switch in the middle, it sends vJoy 1 button 1 off, button 2 on, button 3 off (start state). Pressing Up then gives 1 on, 2 off, 3 off; releasing it the middle again. When added or loaded (no Run) its vJoy writes are refused, by design (06 S4).

scripts.purpose: An R13-style user plugin after upstream's three documented R13 to R14 edits (star import, is_optional, vjoy by vjoy_id/input_id).
scripts.checks: Not configured until Physical button is set. While running, pressing it presses vJoy 1 button 1 (Virtual button) and releasing it releases it.
